verdicts.why: ਮੈਨੂੰ 'to me' glosses a part of LEGO L1 'I think that' (ਮੈਨੂੰ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ); the seed renders it as 'I think', so this is a literal gloss of a word the sentence does not render.
ਕਿ 'that' is the particle in LEGO L1 (…ਸੋਚਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਕਿ); the seed 'Yes I think she could' drops 'that'.
ਹੈ 'is' is in LEGO L1 (ਇਹ ਬਹੁਤ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਹੈ => it's very important); the seed's "it's" fuses the copula into ਇਹ, so 'is' is not a separate substring.
ਬੱਚਾ 'baby' is part of its own LEGO ਬਿੱਲੀ ਦਾ ਬੱਚਾ => 'the kitten'; the seed's 'kitten' does not contain 'baby', so this is a literal gloss of a word inside the LEGO.
ਨਹੀਂ 'not' belongs to LEGO L1 'didn't see anyone'; the seed has "didn't", where the negation is fused into the auxiliary.
ਦੇਖਿਆ 'saw' glosses LEGO L1 'didn't see anyone'; the seed has 'see', so this is an inflected form of a word that is in the sentence.
ਉਹ ਆਈ 'she came' is a literal gloss of LEGO L1 (ਉਹ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿੱਛੇ-ਪਿੱਛੇ ਆਈ => she followed me), whose parts are interposed in the seed 'She followed me down'; the row is about its sentence.
ਕੀਤੀ ਸੀ 'did' glosses part of LEGO L4 'talked to each other'; the seed has 'talked', so this is a lemma/inflection gloss.
ਜਾਣਾ 'go' is the lemma of ਜਾਣ in LEGO L2, which the seed renders as 'walk to school' with no 'go'.
ਹੈ 'is' is in LEGO L2 (ਉਹ ਚਿੰਤਤ ਹੈ => she's worried); the seed's "she's" is a contraction, so 'is' is not a separate substring.
ਕਿ 'that' is the particle in LEGO L1; the seed 'No I don't think she could' drops 'that'.
ਤੇ 'on' glosses part of LEGO L4 ਸਮੇਂ ਤੇ => 'in time'; the seed has 'in time', which renders it as 'in'.
ਕੋਈ 'any' glosses part of LEGO L1 ਕੋਈ ਗੱਲ ਨਹੀਂ => 'no problem'; the seed has 'No problem', which has no 'any'.
ਗੱਲ ਨਹੀਂ 'problem not' glosses LEGO L1 'no problem'; the words are present but reordered.
ਤਰੀਕੇ ਨਾਲ 'way' glosses part of LEGO L1 ਵੱਖਰੇ ਤਰੀਕੇ ਨਾਲ => 'differently'; the seed's 'differently' has no 'way'.
ਕੁਝ 'something' glosses part of LEGO L3 ਕੁਝ ਵੀ => 'anything'; the seed has 'anything', not 'something'.
ਕਰਨਾ 'to do' is the dictionary form inside LEGO L1 ਮਾਫ਼ ਕਰਨਾ => 'I'm sorry'; the seed has no 'do'.
ਤੱਕ 'until' glosses part of LEGO L1 ਹੁਣ ਤੱਕ => 'so far'; the seed has 'so far', not 'until'.
ਜਾਣ ਤੋਂ 'from leaving' glosses LEGO L2 'before you leave'; the seed has 'before you leave', with the words reordered and inflected.
ਸਮੇਂ ਤੋਂ 'for' glosses part of LEGO L1 ਕਿੰਨੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਤੋਂ => 'how long'; the seed 'How long have you been' has no 'for'.
